title: Privacy notice
seo_description: How Hybrid Hub Newquay uses the details you send through our website forms. We never sell your details or add you to a mailing list.
intro: This explains what happens to the details you send us through the Apply to join and drop-in forms on this website.
form_line: We only use your details to contact you about this. We never sell them or add you to a mailing list.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.text: Hybrid Hub Newquay, Prow Park, Newquay TR7 2SX. We are responsible for the details you send us. For any question about your details, email us at info@hybridhubnqy.net.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text:
Only what you type into our forms: your name, email address and phone number, the membership you are interested in, when you would like to train, how you heard about us, and anything else you choose to tell us.

Your form also tells us how you reached our website, for example from Instagram, a Google search or a link we shared. This is the name of the website you came from, never the page you were reading there, and it helps us see which of our posts and listings are working.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text:
We use your details only to contact you about your application or drop-in, and after that only for necessary information about your membership.

We do not create a mailing list or marketing list, and we will not send you marketing emails.

sections.heading: We never sell or share your details
sections.text:
Your details are never sold, rented or given to anyone else, for marketing or for any other purpose.

To get your form to us, it passes through Web3Forms, the service that delivers our website forms, and arrives in our email inbox, which is run by Google Workspace. They handle it on our behalf only, to deliver and store our email, and they are not allowed to use it for anything else.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep your details only for as long as we need them to deal with your enquiry or your membership, and then delete them.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text:
You can ask us at any time to see the details we hold about you, correct them, or delete them. Email info@hybridhubnqy.net and we will reply within one month.

If you are unhappy with how we have handled your details, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.

sections.heading: Browsing this website
sections.text:
This website does not use cookies or advertising trackers, and nothing follows you to other websites.

We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies and does not identify you. It tells us things like how many people visited, which pages they looked at and which websites sent them here, as totals only.

While you browse, your browser remembers the website you arrived from until you close the tab, so that it can go with your form if you send one. It is not sent anywhere unless you send a form.

Some parts are loaded from other companies: the fonts from Google Fonts, the map on the Visit page from Google Maps (which may set its own cookies), and the Instagram photos from Behold. Like any website, these see your device's internet address when they send the content.
